text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper focused on national-scale (China-wide) spatial simulation of land system evolution using a coupled GM-FLUS model. The primary objective is to predict future land use changes (including paddy fields) over 2030–2060 under multiple future climate scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5). The study implements ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison of land use changes and potential rice yields. It reports spatially explicit mapped LULC projections, includes quantitative accuracy metrics for land use simulation (72.89% overall accuracy, kappa=0.65), and analyzes spatial-temporal variations. The paper integrates LULC prediction as a central research question, not incidental, and couples it with crop yield modeling. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction research at the national scale and does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
